program_name: Bachelor of Arts in International Business

programme_facts.value: If you wish to develop your knowledge of business while learning about the influence of politics, law, history and sociology on business decisions, then this programme might be for you. While other business programmes contain an international perspective, this programme provides an extensive international context that will drive your understanding and creativity. On graduation, you can expect to be well-positioned for a career in business, not just in Ireland but with overseas organisations.

value: Enjoy a programme that puts business in an international framework
Be prepared for rewarding graduate-level employment

programme_facts.value: The BA in International Business will provide you with a distinctive and challenging undergraduate experience, structured around a broad and flexible curriculum with subject choices to understand business decisions in a globalized world influenced by political, social and legal issues.
